bestTime.title: Timing suggestion
bestTime.intro: Choose a context before checking. A suggestion does not schedule a post or certify a channel connection.
bestTime.contextHint: This choice only affects the suggestion; it does not change channels in the scheduling form.
bestTime.zoneHint: Windows are calculated in this zone. The form still uses the browser’s local zone; no workspace time zone is changed.
bestTime.optionsError: Channels could not be read. We will not treat this failure as an empty workspace.
bestTime.error: The suggestion could not be confirmed. Refresh to try again; default windows were not presented as the result of this failure.
bestTime.noSelection: No platform or account was assumed. Choose a channel or a generic reference.
bestTime.selectAgain: The chosen context is no longer available. Please select again.
bestTime.referenceReason: Generic editorial reference for the platform, without using account history.
bestTime.channelBaselineReason: Attributed records: {{count}}. There is not enough eligible evidence or comparable signal to rank windows by results; using an editorial reference.
bestTime.observedReason: Attributed history for this channel: {{count}} sends; {{samples}} support this window. This is a relative comparison, not a reach forecast.
bestTime.fillOnly: Only fills the date and time. Review the content and channels, then confirm scheduling separately.
bestTime.expired: This window is too close or has passed. Refresh the suggestion before using it.
bestTime.readonly: You can view suggestions. Editing access is required to fill or create scheduled posts.
bestTime.cadenceReason_low_budget: With {{hours}} hours available per week, start with a small target and adapt it to your routine.
bestTime.cadenceReason_daily_budget: With {{hours}} hours available per week, a daily post is a reference, not an obligation.
bestTime.cadenceReason_beginner: A conservative starting reference. Adjust it to your routine; this is not a promise of growth.
bestTime.cadenceReason_platform_default: An editorial reference for the platform, not a reach forecast or an obligation to publish.
bestTime.methodTitle: Source and limits of the suggestion
bestTime.method: History includes completed publications with an external ID and persisted observations attributed to the same channel, content and send. Recorded send start is a timing proxy, not the exact instant a post went public. Each publication’s latest cumulative collection counts only once.
bestTime.threshold: To use history in the ranking: at least {{total}} attributed sends, {{perSlot}} per window and comparable positive signal. Default windows are not personalized data.
bestTime.historyScope: Scope: up to {{max}} completed sends in the last {{days}} days. This is not the account’s entire history.
bestTime.rateBasis: Rates use the same denominator for every record: impressions, or reach when complete. Without comparable coverage, counts are used instead.
bestTime.countBasis: Comparison uses engagement counts for every record: part of the history had no positive denominator. Counts and rates were not mixed.
bestTime.noGuarantee: The ordering also considers waiting time. This heuristic does not measure percentage gains, guarantee performance, or confirm OAuth access or provider approval.

strategy.instagram: Try a clear opening and review media requirements and link destinations before publishing.

strategy.linkedin: Explain the main idea early and review media and link requirements.
strategy.google_business: Consider search intent and the selected location. Review the offer, validity and call to action.
strategy.x: Review concision, context and format limits. A planning reference does not enable publishing.
strategy.threads: Prioritize conversation and clarity. A planning reference does not enable publishing.
strategy.pinterest: Use clear titles and descriptions for search. A planning reference does not enable publishing.

diagnostics.formula:
Presence: 40 points for having a brand + up to 60 for three registered channels.
Identity: average of configured voice (35), palette (35) and logo (30) in the analyzed brands.
Content inventory: 8 points per registered item, capped at 100; includes drafts and archived items.
Recent activity: 12 points per item created in the last 30 days, capped at 100; future dates are excluded.
Queue completion: successes with a non-simulated reference / (those successes + definitive failures without a reference or reconciliation). Pending, cancelled, simulated, future and uncertain results are excluded. No evidence means zero with a warning.
Recorded connections: percentage of connected channels with no known authorization issue or recorded revocation; this is not a live connection check.
Overall Score: presence 18%, identity 17%, content 20%, activity 18%, queue 14% and connections 13%, rounded. Health groups these pillars into five areas.
Version velt-records-v2. Reads are limited to the 500 most recent records per source, also ordered by ID. No external validation, outcome prediction or rewriting of legacy records.

skillMapNative.readErrorHint: A failed read does not mean an empty map or a zero score. This read did not start a save. Try rereading only.
skillMapNative.loading: Reading your assessments… This does not yet confirm that records are absent.
skillMapNative.stale: A new read could not be confirmed
skillMapNative.staleHint: Previous data remains visible. It is not a confirmed current read; review and save stay blocked until a valid read.
skillMapNative.reading: Rereading assessments. Your previous data and draft are preserved; wait before reviewing or saving.
skillMapNative.empty: A complete read found no assessments of yours in this workspace. Choose an area and enter a score; missing data will never be treated as a mastered skill.
skillMapNative.methodTitle: How this map works and what it does not measure
skillMapNative.methodBands: The 0–29, 30–79 and 80–100 bands only organize the declared scale. They are not a diagnosis, proven mastery or a growth promise. Counts cover only your ten areas in this workspace.
skillMapNative.methodCurrent: There is one current record per account, workspace and area. A reassessment replaces score, notes, source and date without keeping an immutable history on this screen.
skillMapNative.methodTechnical: confidence and evidence are original technical data, not calibrated or verified. They are preserved on update and do not prove the score. New records use the technical default confidence 0.5 and empty evidence.
skillMapNative.methodBrain: Saving does not generate AI, complete learning paths or recalculate saved Score, Brain or recommendations. Other modules may read this record in a later query.
skillMapNative.methodLimits: Version checking protects this API, not every possible writer. The lock only covers this runtime, not other tabs, reloads or devices. The UUID is a reference, not distributed idempotency. Real Auth, RLS and concurrency require separate validation.
skillMapNative.runtimeHint: The draft stays only in memory for this account and workspace. It survives navigation in the same runtime, but not a reload, closing the page, session clearing or cache expiry after five inactive minutes. Dates use the São Paulo timezone.
